summary: Full end-to-end testing of DealPicker (Next.js 15). Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (health, empty products, 10 categories, 15 brands, search brands, newsletter valid/invalid, contact, admin login success + wrong-password 401, /me with/without token, brute-force 429 confirmed after 5 fails, sitemap.xml, robots.txt). Frontend: homepage hero + empty state + 10 category cards + brands marquee + newsletter (toast success) + footer socials all render. Language switch EN->HI works and persists in localStorage 'dp_locale'. Theme toggle switches dark<->light on <html>. Back-to-top appears on scroll>500px and scrolls to top on click. Admin login (/admin/login) with correct creds redirects to /admin and shows 'Signed in as admin@dealpicker.in'; Sign out redirects back to /admin/login. Category /category/mobiles shows heading + empty state, brand /brand/apple renders heading. Custom 404 for /random-page-doesnt-exist works with 404 status and Return home/Search deals buttons. About, Contact, all 5 legal pages, buying-guides, reviews, comparisons all return 200 with content.

issues: Renders the 404 not-found UI (Return home / Search deals) but the HTTP status is 200 instead of 404. Custom top-level /random-page-doesnt-exist correctly returns HTTP 404. For dynamic /category/[slug] the page likely renders <NotFound /> as a component instead of calling Next.js notFound() which would surface a proper 404 status. Consider calling notFound() from the server component when slug is invalid so bots/SEO see 404.

action_items: Minor: For /category/[slug] (and /brand/[slug]) with invalid slugs, call Next.js notFound() from the server component so the HTTP response is 404 (currently renders 404 UI with 200 status). Not blocking functionally.
Minor spec/testid mismatch: BackToTop uses data-testid='back-to-top-button' while the review request mentioned 'back-to-top'. Functionality is fine; align spec or component naming if desired.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth: bcrypt+jsonwebtoken + brute-force lockout (5 fails -> 429) verified working end-to-end.
Public product API correctly returns empty [] (no fake seed) as required.
i18n: dp_locale persists in localStorage and Hindi hero string renders correctly.
Consider returning HTTP 404 (via notFound()) for invalid dynamic route slugs to keep SEO/bots aligned with the visible not-found UI.
seed_data_creation: None. Requirement mandates no fake products; empty state verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest suite at /app/backend/tests/test_dealpicker_api.py covers all public + auth + sitemap/robots endpoints. Run: `cd /app && python -m pytest backend/tests/test_dealpicker_api.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Note brute-force test uses a random email each run so it doesn't lock the real admin. Frontend testids: newsletter-email-input, newsletter-submit-button, lang-en, lang-hi, nav-theme-toggle, back-to-top-button, category-card-<slug>, footer-instagram-link, footer-twitter-link, footer-telegram-link.
rca of the issue: N/A — no blocking bugs. Only observation: invalid dynamic slug pages render 404 UI with HTTP 200; fix by invoking Next.js notFound() in the [slug]/page.js server component when slug is not in the allowed set.
